name: Seong Byeong-suk
bio: Seong Byeong-suk (성병숙) is a South Korean stage, television, film, and voice actress.

credits.title: Cane Girl
credits.overview: For Minseo, who is only 15 years old, life is a daily struggle. She has to look after her baby brother, work at a part-time job and deal with school bullies. She happens to meet a granny who is a “Cane-Fu” master.

credits.title: Cattle Run
credits.overview: Brothers living like strangers for over 30 years, Man-su and Byung-su raise cattle separately but get caught up in an unexpected crisis together.

credits.title: Love Unlike in K-Dramas
credits.overview: A surprise trip to Seoul reunites Dhea with an old flame, forcing her to face past feelings and question her current relationship.

credits.title: The Unrighteous
credits.overview: In an old multi-family house, Wonjung Villa, Joo-hyun casually puts the missionary paper of the cult-church received by accident into the mailbox of Shin-hye. Shin-hye gradually devotes herself to the church and passionately evangelizes her neighbors for treating her sick son.

credits.title: Wonderland
credits.overview: In a world where an AI programme allows people to communicate with their deceased loved ones, a flight attendant and a mother question the meaning of reality and humanity.

credits.title: Picnic
credits.overview: After a surprise visit from her friend Geum-sun, Eun-sim is headed to her hometown with Geum-sun. There, she catches up with Tae-ho who had feelings for her when they were teenagers. Her long-lost memories come to life one by one.

credits.title: Badland Hunters
credits.overview: After a deadly earthquake turns Seoul into a lawless badland, a fearless huntsman springs into action to rescue a teenager abducted by a mad doctor.

credits.title: Switch
credits.overview: A story of how Park Kang's life is changed on Christmas day.  Park Kang is a popular actor, but he is also a scandal maker. His manager is Jo Yoon and they are also long-time friends. One day, Park Kang's ex-girlfriend Soo-hyun suddenly appears in front of Park Kang.

credits.title: Air Murder
credits.overview: The massive scandal comes to light through a father's unwavering search for the truth behind the sudden death of his family.

credits.title: The Box
credits.overview: A drama about a young man aspiring to become a singer and a washed-up former hit producer. The two men head off on a road trip filled with music and jamming sessions.

credits.title: Black Money
credits.overview: A prosecutor is falsely accused of sexual assault in a suicide note from a woman that he is convinced was actually murdered. As he investigates her death to clear his name, he realizes that the truth lies in a huge financial scandal.

credits.title: Happy Together
credits.overview: A son and father earn a living working at night. This movie depicts their heart wrenching story.

credits.title: Stand by Me
credits.overview: A grandpa finds out he is not going to live for much longer so he decides to prepare for his grandson's future with something special.

credits.title: Seven Years of Night
credits.overview: Set against the haunting backdrop of a small lake town, this chilling thriller unravels a meticulous revenge set over a period of 7 years, all beginning with the accidental death of an innocent girl.

credits.title: Be-Bop-A-Lula
credits.overview: Old age is an inevitable future for every human being. But these four old men are not willing to succumb to time or the younger generations; they are ready to make their own decisions and overcome any obstacle. They try to live the rest of their lives to the fullest and achieve life goals.

credits.title: The Running Actress
credits.overview: A collection of three short films directed by Moon So-ri. During recent years, Moon tried writing and directing. credits.overview: A clever king of Joseon and his brilliant chronicler hunt for the truth behind a crime that threatens the throne and the stability of the country.

credits.title: Luck-Key
credits.overview: A reverse comedy that tells the story of a perfectionist assassin who falls and hits his head in a sauna, giving him amnesia. When a down-and-out actor switches locker keys with him, they switch lives until the hit-man, who soon becomes an action hero on TV, starts to remember things.

credits.title: The Great Actor
credits.overview: A breakthrough opportunity comes when internationally - renowned director Park announces an open call for his new film, and Jang begins intense preparation for the role of his life.

credits.title: The Himalayas
credits.overview: Based on true events, renowned mountaineer Um Hong-gil sets out on a mission to Everest to retrieve his late junior climber's body and faces the greatest challenge of his life.

credits.overview: The Plan Man is about a man who lives everything according to plan until he meets a woman who wasn't a part of it.

credits.overview: A disgraced chef tries to restore his name by competing in a culinary contest to win the knife of Korea's last royal chef.
